authorization_rule.rule: automatic only for AE_PRIMARY causes on AUTO_ELIGIBLE devices named automatic in a valid written scope in mode active-authorized, and only if every window of the confirmation run is AE-caused; context, mixed, liveness, identity and unattributed causes are operator-reviewed; RESTORE is always a manual operator action

liveness_policy.rule: RESTRICT recommendation when silent longer than 3 x AE window + 10 s with complete observer coverage, after a delivery in the current policy generation; RC-1-explained intervals and observer outages never count; no trust score; always operator review

qualification.rule: Screen R (R1-R6) as recorded in the authority map; unchanged in the stabilization campaign

recovery_rule.name: POST_RESTORE_ONE_WINDOW_V1
recovery_rule.rule: after a verified operator RESTORE the device's first score-ready AE window is recorded and held (no request, confirmation run reset); identity and context-only decisions are not suppressed
